speaker: Devotee (deciding refuge)
question: Who has not gone to refuge?
premises: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt.
O master, 'he you are' having decided — who has not gone to you as refuge?
inference: Deciding 'he you are', all take refuge; none has not.

speaker: Devotee (hoping shine)
question: May hope shine in Śambhu?
premises: Having enjoyed enjoyments, having dropped becoming-delusion, I will attain the supreme state.
Thus the hope here: may it shine supremely of the devout in Śambhu.
inference: Enjoyed and dropped, may attainment-hope shine in Śambhu.

speaker: Devotee (content in dependence)
question: What do or say in dream?
premises: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad.
With pride of dependence on you — everywhere here I am content.
inference: Dependent-pride makes every dream act content.

speaker: Devotee (declaring impossibility)
question: What touch of darkness?
premises: Of lights even which light — there in your abode of the running mind.
O lord of mind, touch of darkness — I think, barren-woman's-son's-younger-brother.
inference: Darkness touching your abode-mind is impossible.

speaker: Devotee (thinking service)
question: Whose wish stands on the path?
premises: I think, foot placed even on the benign path of liberation.
Stands whose wish: 'I will serve Śiva' — this.
inference: The serving-Śiva wish stands placed on liberation's path.

speaker: Devotee (acknowledging power)
question: Whose free power oversees the loom?
premises: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here.
Alone indeed, O lord, your power — free — the loom you oversee.
inference: Your alone free power oversees the three-world loom.

option_choices.reason: Free (predicate of power); as-free adverbial same freedom, T1 kept.
You-oversee (loom supervised); consider same īkṣ, T1 oversee kept.

speaker: Devotee (bowing to lake)
question: To which extinction-lake bow?
premises: In three worlds here who is saved, by triple suffering not afflicted.
To him let bow be, to you — who you are that extinction-nectar-lake.
inference: Bow to you, extinction-nectar-lake saving from triple pain.

speaker: Devotee (questioning fruit)
question: What-fruited if guileless?
premises: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising.
If this were guileless, what-fruited — by you let it be said.
inference: Artificial devotion fruits; guileless — what fruit? You say.

speaker: Devotee (naming eye and way)
question: What eye sees, what way reaches?
premises: That eye by which you are seen, that way by which you are reached.
That fruit, O unborn, is born — from wish-tree of talk about you.
inference: Seeing-eye and reaching-way fruit from talk's wish-tree.

speaker: Devotee (taking refuge)
question: Who removes obstacles?
premises: Better than good indeed is this — above, in you, which standing.
For removing obstacles to that, you, O lord, are my refuge.
inference: You are refuge removing obstacles to standing in you.
